The line segment XY― is a diameter of a circle. Given that X and Y have coordinates (−3,2) and (3,4), respectively, what is the equation of the circle?

a
x2+(y+3)2=10
b
(x−3)2+y2=10
c
x2+(y−3)2=10
d
(x−3)2−y2=10
e
(x+3)2+y2=10
